purpose: Phase 1D engineering audit of the fixed simulation count N=25,000. N is an ENGINEERING choice (Monte Carlo error vs football-model error); it is never chosen from football scores.

predetermined_burned_set.note: chosen by fixed rule before any run: one 2025 early-mid week, one 2025 late-mid week, the last burned week; disjoint from the dry-run weeks

criteria.C1_mean_mc_se: for each core outcome: mean over rows of (sd_row / sqrt(N)) divided by the empirical model RMSE of the mean forecast on the same rows <= 0.01
criteria.C2_crps_vs_reference: |mean CRPS(N=25k) - mean CRPS(N=100k reference, independent seed)| / mean CRPS(N=100k) <= 0.005 for each core outcome
criteria.C3_tail_probability_se: for the key tail probabilities P(rush_yds>=75), P(rec_yds>=100), P(pass_yds>=300), P(anytime TD>=1): the largest per-row Monte Carlo SE sqrt(p(1-p)/N) over the set, and the largest empirical SD across 4 repeated 25k runs, are both <= 0.005
criteria.C4_repeat_stability: across 4 repeated 25k runs with different seeds, for published mean/median/p10/p90: mean over rows of |run_i - run_ref| divided by the empirical model RMSE <= 0.02 and the 95th percentile over rows <= 0.05, for each core outcome

if_any_criterion_fails: report a blocker; do not search for another N by football score
